button.enterEmail: Enter the email address of your e-book reader. You only have to do this once.
button.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
button.tooLarge: Too large to send ({0} MB, limit {1} MB)
button.notConfigured: The administrator has not set up a mail server yet
button.senderHint: Approve {0} as a sender in your reader account, otherwise the mail is dropped.
admin.smtpIntro: These credentials are used to send books for every user on this server.
admin.presetDesc: Fills in host, port and encryption. Username and password still have to be entered.
admin.securityDesc: Port 465 needs "SSL/TLS on connect". Versions up to 1.2.0.0 could only do STARTTLS, which is why port 465 never worked.
admin.userDesc: Leave empty for a relay that needs no login.
admin.passwordDesc: Gmail, Outlook and most providers reject your normal account password here. Create an app password instead.
admin.passwordStored: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.senderDesc: Leave empty to use the username. This address must be approved in the reader account, otherwise every mail bounces.
admin.testOk: Connection successful. The server accepted the login.
admin.testMailDesc: A connection test only proves that login works. It cannot detect that the reader vendor rejects your sender address - send a real test message to check that.
admin.testMailOk: Test message sent. If nothing arrives, the sender address is most likely not approved at the recipient.
admin.conversionLabel: Ask Amazon to convert to Kindle format
admin.conversionDesc: Sends "convert" as the subject line. Only relevant for Amazon Kindle; leave off for other readers.
admin.maxSizeDesc: Provider limit for the whole email. Amazon allows 50 MB.
admin.effectiveLimit: Largest sendable file: about {0} MB (attachments grow when encoded).
admin.usersDesc: Every user sets their own reader address under Settings > E-Book Share. Nobody can see or change another user's address.
user.title: E-Book Share
user.emailDesc: Books you send are delivered to this address. Only you can see and change it.
user.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
user.noSmtp: Your administrator has not set up a mail server yet. Sending will not work until they do.
user.helpTitle: Where do I find this address?
user.help1: Open your Amazon account and go to "Manage Your Content and Devices".
user.help2: Switch to "Preferences" and open "Personal Document Settings".
user.help3: Copy the address ending in @kindle.com and paste it above.
user.help4: In the same place, add your server's sender address to the approved list - Amazon silently drops mail from unapproved senders.
user.senderHint: Sender address used by this server:
user.testMailOk: Test message sent. If nothing arrives within a few minutes, the sender address above is most likely not approved in your reader account.
